description: This file defines the PageSetupRenderer class responsible for rendering page setup configurations into RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library.

classes.name: PageSetupRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders PageSetup objects as RTF content, including page margins, orientation, size, and section start details.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to render the PageSetup object into RTF by writing the appropriate control words and attributes.

methods.name: RenderPageDistances
methods.description: Handles rendering of page margins, header, and footer distances.

methods.name: RenderSectionStart
methods.description: Handles rendering of section start attributes like starting page number and section breaking.
